svg.desc: Every instruction word coloured by the task that executed it (measured), or by shape for bitmap runs.

svg.text: Each row is one 256-word page; each sliver one instruction. Colour = the main-loop task or interrupt that was running when the word executed (measured).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bitmap runs are coloured by shape. Words never executed in the scenarios fall back to a static assignment, or grey.
